source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top BM parses
summary: 1:1 Steady Shot weave (Auto → Steady → Auto → Steady). Kill Command on cooldown. Keep Serpent Sting up. Bestial Wrath on cooldown.

Aspect of the Monkey.note: should be in Aspect of the Hawk for DPS  -  Monkey is for melee avoidance only

Aspect of the Viper.note: sustained Viper use means running OOM  -  check mana consumables and shot timing

Wing Clip.note: melee slow on a ranged DPS parse  -  usually a wrong keybind or panic button

Scatter Shot.note: a CC tool used heavily on single-target  -  DPS loss unless assigned to interrupt/CC

Volley.note: AoE used on a single-target encounter  -  likely a misfire

Explosive Trap.note: trap used on single-target boss  -  rarely correct outside niche mechanics

breakpoint.note: Steady Shot should be the dominant ability after auto attacks. BM's power is in the pet (30 - 40% of damage)  -  Ferocious Inspiration (+3% raid damage) is a key raid contribution. Kill Command should appear every ~15 seconds. Heavy Arcane Shot counts relative to Steady Shot can indicate shot clipping.

advisory: The 1:1 weave (one Steady Shot per auto shot) is the TBC BM baseline. Bestial Wrath + The Beast Within gives 18 seconds of +50% pet damage every 2 minutes  -  it should appear in the log regularly. Missing Kill Command from the cast list entirely means the ability may not be on the action bar.
